name: Swimming
description: Swimming word search puzzles gather pool-and-stroke English for adults and seniors — lap, lane, kick, freestyle, backstroke and calm water-sport words — without club brands or Olympic trademarks. Every grid is free online with no download, no account and no timer. Choose easy across-and-down warm-ups, medium grids with diagonals, hard puzzles in all eight directions, or large print with bigger letters on a smaller board. The list stays familiar and paced: glide, float, towel, shallow, endurance and warmup vocabulary many lap swimmers already know. This hub sits under our Sports collection and pairs well with Ocean, Lakes and Hiking when you want a longer active-but-calm session. Prefer bigger type? Start with large print. New solvers can read how to play, then pick a difficulty as steady as a long freestyle length.
